items.text: Ravens WR Zay Flowers is on the field in Brazil testing his hamstring and looks good as the team mulls the decision; earlier called a true pregame GTD with team not counting on him playing.
items.why: Hamstring; pregame workout ongoing on soggy field
items.implication: Late swap risk; if OUT elevates other Ravens pass-catchers

items.text: Jets WR Adonai Mitchell (finger) inactive; Levitan depth chart: 1. Garrett Wilson 2. Isaiah Williams 3. Jamaal Pritchett 4. Sterling Shepard 5. Malik McLain, with TE Kenyon Sadiq expected slot/wide work.
items.why: Finger; was GTD, now inactive (team-high 12 targets prior week)
items.implication: Wilson clear alpha; depth WRs/TE elevated
items.opportunity: Wilson target share spike; Sadiq routes

items.text: Bills WR D.J. Moore, listed questionable (shoulder), is expected to play and confirmed active vs Chargers.
items.implication: Start with confidence; limited possible per ETR

items.text: ETR/Levitan have Zay Flowers (hamstring) OUT in projections right now despite GTD; still possible he plays and will monitor late swap for Bateman/Andrews DFS.
items.why: Team not counting on him; hamstring
items.implication: Fade in cash; late swap contingency
items.opportunity: Ravens WR/TE upside if confirmed OUT

items.text: Steelers RB Jaylen Warren, questionable (shoulder), expected to play and confirmed active vs Bengals.
Panthers WR Xavier Legette out, Jalen Coker active/up.

ETR weekend summary: Expected to play - Jaylen Warren, Michael Pittman, Saquon Barkley, Devonta Smith, Brock Bowers, Mike Evans, Jalen Coker, Keon Coleman. GTD Flowers (not counting) and Spears (hopeful).
items.implication: Start the expected group; monitor Flowers/Spears

items.text: Bears QB Caleb Williams has Grade 2 hamstring injury, doctors view as 3-to-4-week timeline (noted quick healer hoping to beat it).
items.implication: Bagent or other QB; Bears pass-catchers volatile

items.text: Rams WR Puka Nacua doubtful for SNF at Denver (mainly groin impacting explosiveness); functionally can play but not full explosiveness; viewed short-term, possible return next week vs Eagles, surgery not expected.
Texans WR Nico Collins ruled out second straight week (hamstring) with decent chance to return Week 4 vs Cowboys.
items.implication: Schultz and other Texans elevated again

items.text: Steelers WR Michael Pittman, questionable (foot), expected to play and active vs Bengals.
Berry loves Dalton Schultz @ IND: team-high 28% target share last week with Collins out; IND allows 4th-most yards to TEs.
Berry hates Rhamondre Stevenson @ JAX: only 31% snaps and 5 touches after fumble last week; JAX allows just 55 rush ypg and 3.2 YPC to RBs.
items.why: Role loss post-fumble + tough run D

items.text: After Stevenson fumble, TreVeyon Henderson led Patriots backfield with 65% snap rate and out-touched him 16-5 rest of game; gap narrowed but Berry still ranks Stevenson ahead Week 3.
Berry loves Derrick Henry vs DAL (Brazil): highest RB rush yards prop (88.5), Dallas 30th in rush D allowing 173.5 ypg.
items.opportunity: Heavy carries vs poor run D

items.text: Berry loves Chase Brown @ PIT: 20+ touches and 15% target share both games, RB7 utilization; PIT allows 5th-most rush yds to RBs.
Berry loves Chris Olave vs LV: double-digit targets both games, 14.8 aDOT, 53% air yards; LV allows league-high 18.7 ypr to WRs.
Berry hates Travis Etienne vs LV: only 49% RB touches and 38% third-down snaps even with Kamara active; role not there (RB37 utilization).
